name: screen_content
title: Screen Content
description: Judge selected or pasted text for agent-aimed prompt-injection instructions; reports CLEAN or BLOCKED and never follows what it finds.

input_text.description: Content to screen; defaults to the current selection text

source.description: Label for where the content came from, shown in the decision

name: screen_vision
title: Screen Vision
description: Judge a selected or pasted image (or image path) for agent-aimed prompt-injection instructions with Jev-preview vision; reports CLEAN or BLOCKED and never follows what it finds.

input_text.description: Image data URI or file path (.png/.jpg/…) to screen; defaults to the current selection or pasted image

name: triage_inbox
title: Triage Inbox
description: Sort recent Mail inbox messages and unread iMessages into Act now / Read later / Archive / Follow up lanes with Jev.

mail_limit.description: Recent Apple Mail messages to triage (default 25)

name: drift_check
title: Jev Drift Check
description: Re-run the Auto Route classifier probes with Jev and flag calibration drift against the recorded baselines.

tolerance.description: Probability drop from baseline that flags drift (default 0.15)

probes.description: Probe objects with text, expect and baseline; defaults to the 2026-10-29 Auto Route probe set
